about_the_game:
In Silent Fangs: Stealthy Vampire’s Tale, you awaken in a forgotten crypt, weakened and alone. Once a feared ruler of the night, you must now reclaim your power in a world that has long since buried your name. Set in a gothic medieval landscape and rendered in retro PS1 aesthetics, this fast-paced first-person stealth adventure challenges you to rise again.

Leap across battlements, infiltrate occupied castles, and silently dispatch those who stand in your way using precise parkour and stealth mechanics. With each conquered stronghold, your influence grows—and so does your power.

But you’re not alone in your dark quest. Along the way, you’ll encounter a strange cast of funny yet intriguing NPCs—gravediggers, cursed jesters, potion-sellers, and other medieval oddities—who will aid you with cryptic advice, questionable tools, and unexpected friendship.

  • PS1-Inspired Gothic World – Immerse yourself in a richly atmospheric medieval setting with low-poly visuals and haunting vibes.

  • Stealth + Parkour Gameplay – Wall-run, leap, climb, and sneak through enemy territory with fluid mobility and deadly silence.

  • Castle Conquest System – Reclaim one fortress at a time to rebuild your dominion and revive the age of vampires.

  • Memorable NPC Encounters – Meet bizarre allies who offer both comedy and mystery on your dark journey.

  • Evolving Power – Regain your vampiric abilities as you grow stronger, unlocking new traversal and combat options.

Will you return as ruler of the night, or fade once more into myth?

content_descriptors.notes: Contains stylized fantasy violence, blood effects, and dark supernatural themes. No sexual content, self-harm, or drug/alcohol use.
